cpu_vs_gpu.note: GPU acceleration unavailable on this host; no GPU embedding time was measured. CPU baseline retained from Phase 5.

conclusion: GPU acceleration UNAVAILABLE — the Intel iGPU is visible to the kernel (i915 driver, vendor 0x8086) and to Vulkan (Intel Iris Xe Graphics (RPL-P)), but the OpenVINO GPU plugin registers no devices because the intel Level-Zero / compute runtime libraries are absent and cannot be installed without root.
